rests_on: DELTA_B_TRAJECTORY_CORRECTED_RESULT.json (all 6 contracts + Rule 14 live attestation passed; replication gate COMPATIBLE: fresh delta_B(final)=-0.109 vs corrected-crossover -0.156, both well inside [-0.40,+0.05])
HEADLINE: PEAK_THEN_DECLINE fires, confirmed. Corrected pi_B3 DID acquire the Pole-B specialization -- decisively, at t=100k -- and then lost it over the remaining 900k steps of training. This is not 'B cannot learn the regime'; it is 'B learned it and then something eroded it'.

t100k.note: PASSES mean>0 AND LCB95>0 in isolation -- a genuinely significant positive delta_B

slope.reading: a statistically confirmed OVERALL DECLINE (entire interval negative) across the ten post-warm-start points, but this is a straight-line fit through a genuinely wobbly curve -- not a claim that erosion is monotone or steady.

peak_minus_final.reading: CONFIRMED: t100k beats the final checkpoint by a wide, entirely-positive margin. This is the estimand that fires PEAK_THEN_DECLINE.

endpoint_final_minus_100k.reading: the mirror image of peak_minus_final, reported for transparency -- same finding stated the other direction.

BRANCH_FIRED.condition_check: argmax over interior points = t100k, which is < tfinal (0.1M < 1.001M): TRUE. LCB95(delta_B(t100k) - delta_B(tfinal)) = +0.1406 > 0: TRUE. Both conditions met.
BRANCH_FIRED.precedence_note: this branch takes precedence over STUCK by the spec's own precedence rule. The slope IS negative enough that STUCK's raw condition (UCB95(slope)<=0) is also technically satisfied, but STUCK's prescribed action -- move to a B-specific coordination/mechanism repair -- would be the WRONG call here: the mechanism demonstrably worked at t100k. Acting on STUCK instead of PEAK_THEN_DECLINE would have wasted the finding.
BRANCH_FIRED.reading: a better Pole-B specialist already exists among the nine checkpoints already paid for. The failure is late-training erosion, not an inability to learn the regime.
BRANCH_FIRED.NOT_the_finding: this is NOT evidence that Pole B needs a different coordination mechanism, an assignment signal, or a representation change. The current architecture and recipe DID produce the specialization -- briefly.

SELECTION_BIAS_RULE_now_actively_binding.text_from_spec: NO checkpoint selected here may be claimed to make 4v4 pass, however good it looks. Any candidate MUST be re-evaluated under the full joint crossover on a FRESH CONFIRMATORY block, against BOTH poles, before any pass/fail claim.
SELECTION_BIAS_RULE_now_actively_binding.why_this_matters_concretely_here: t100k was identified as the best of 11 evaluated points. Even though it independently clears LCB95>0, that clearance is partly a product of having looked at 11 candidates and picked the winner -- the true effect size at t100k is likely somewhat smaller than the naive +0.172 point estimate. The number that will actually decide whether t100k is real is a FRESH bootstrap on FRESH seeds, not this one.
SELECTION_BIAS_RULE_now_actively_binding.what_must_happen_before_any_pass_claim: a full joint crossover (pi_A3 vs pi_B3@t100k, BOTH Pole A and Pole B, both deltas) on a fresh confirmatory seed block, exactly the protocol the sealed and corrected crossovers already used.

CONSISTENCY_CHECK_t0_across_two_independ.reading: both intervals overlap almost completely. These are two independent draws of the identical construct (same t0 checkpoint, same frozen pi_A3, same attested Pole B) on disjoint seed blocks -- ordinary sampling variation, not a discrepancy. This is a free consistency check, not a requirement of the frozen spec, and it passes.

WHAT_THE_SHAPE_SUGGESTS_stated_as_hypoth.observation: the curve is not a clean monotone decline. It has a sharp early peak (t100k), returns to near-zero by t200k, wanders through several noisy points (t300k-t700k, none individually significant), drops to a confirmed trough at t800k-t900k, then partially recovers by tfinal.
candidate_mechanisms_not_yet_distinguish: catastrophic forgetting / policy drift: PPO continuing to optimize the shared reward objective erodes an early, narrow behavioral solution that happened to specialize, without any pressure to preserve it
an unstable specialization equilibrium: the specialized behavior is not a fixed point of the training dynamics -- the policy can pass through it but reward gradients pull it elsewhere
reward-shaping pressure unrelated to specialization pulling the policy toward a different, more generically-rewarded behavior that happens to be weaker specifically against Pole B
WHAT_THE_SHAPE_SUGGESTS_stated_as_hypoth.this_reading_does_not_adjudicate_between: distinguishing these requires behavioral inspection (what does t100k's policy actually do differently from tfinal's on Pole B?), not another aggregate win-rate measurement.

PRECOMMITTED_NEXT_STEPS_in_order: 1. CONFIRMATORY VALIDATION of t100k: full joint crossover (pi_A3 vs pi_B3@t100k, both poles) on a fresh confirmatory seed block. This is required before t100k may be treated as anything more than a promising exploratory signal, per the selection-bias rule above.

2. IF t100k's joint gate passes: this becomes the candidate checkpoint. The research question shifts to WHY continued training erodes it -- a tractable, well-precedented class of problem (entropy floor, LR schedule, early stopping, KL-anchoring to the peak) rather than a representation or coordination redesign.

3. IF t100k's joint gate does NOT pass on fresh seeds: the peak was itself partly a seed-block artifact inflated by selection, and the investigation returns to the STUCK reading -- but only then, not before.
WHAT_THIS_READING_MAY_NOT_BE_USED_TO_CLA: that t100k makes 4v4 pass -- not yet validated on fresh seeds against both poles
that continued training is definitively harmful in general -- only that it eroded THIS particular early solution
a mechanism for the erosion -- three candidates are named, none distinguished
anything about Pole A or about 6v6/2v2
any confirmatory status for this run itself -- exploratory seeds, n=64, diagnostic arm
NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED: the confirmatory validation of t100k (step 1 above) requires a fresh confirmatory seed block and is not yet authorized.
